title: Project decision state and facts without calling a model
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` with a deliberate projection bind (ticket + channel; secret omitted). He performs `run_recipe` and verifies the project_state node omits secrets, records facts fingerprints, and never invokes a model. [^rvania-decision] [^rc-dp-proj]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` via `DecisionPlaneTemplate` and `ProjectStateRunner` / `project_decision_state`. Product CLI verb `run_recipe` with `DecisionPlaneRecipeAdapter`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `project_state.yaml` drives `run_recipe` with bind path; hard expects on projection/facts observation keys.
